source: docs/planning/cutscene-and-lived-in-asset-prompts-2026-10-08.md (S2-S5 shots and shared style block); the operator is the player's own class model
style: The shared cinematic style and identity locks are injected by build-clip-jobs.mjs; this file contains scene direction only.

scout.name: Scout
scout.look: a slim operator in glossy bone-white armour plates over a black bodysuit, a sealed rounded white helmet with a black visor, an orange light on one knee and a cyan light on the other

tank.name: Tank
tank.look: a huge hulking operator in heavy weathered olive-brown power armour with massive rounded pauldrons, a sealed helmet with a narrow amber visor slit, small amber and cyan status lights

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.look: a lean operator in tan and gunmetal utility armour with chunky forearm tool braces, a sealed tan helmet with a glowing cyan visor, an orange light on one knee and a cyan light on the other

camp.firstFrame: Low wide shot of a survivors' camp in a vast dark bunker hall, an oil-drum fire in the centre throwing flickering orange light over a ring of bedrolls, supply crates and sandbag walls, {operator} sitting on a bedroll, helmet sealed, warming gloved hands at the fire, two adult survivors in patched coats and hoods silhouetted across the flames with their faces in shadow, laundry strung between pipes, monumental bone arches bound in black iron, with a sparse living cable system visible only where the bindings have split, vanishing into black overhead, sparks rising.
camp.lastFrame: the same camp asleep, the fire burned down to a bed of glowing embers, the operator a dark shape curled on the bedroll, the survivors asleep under blankets, a single sentry silhouetted at the sandbag barricade, fog creeping in under the barricade.
camp.action: Slow quarter-orbit around the fire, ending high and wide over the camp. The operator lies back on the bedroll. A survivor feeds a broken chair leg into the flames, sending up a short burst of sparks, then lies down. The firelight gradually dims to an ember glow; shadows lengthen. Fog creeps along the floor. Fade to black.

cryo.firstFrame: An emergency thermal cryo pod standing upright in a frozen chamber, its ribbed glass lid half open and furred with frost, {operator} stepping into a fitted pressure cradle lined with segmented bruised-maroon shock cushions, helmet sealed, cyan instrument light washing over the frost from a strip inside the pod, icicles hanging from bone-braced coolant conduits overhead, white fog pouring slowly out of the pod's base across a floor of black ice.
cryo.lastFrame: the cryo pod sealed shut, its glass lid covered in dense fern-like frost so the operator is only a dark silhouette behind it, the cyan light inside dimmed to a faint standby glow, the frozen chamber silent and almost black.
cryo.action: Slow, steady push toward the pod. The operator settles back into the cradle and the lid swings closed with a soft hiss of vapour. Frost blooms across the glass from the edges inward in branching ferns until the silhouette inside is barely visible. A cyan light pulses three times, each slower than the last, then dims. Fog stops moving. Fade to black.

hive.firstFrame: Deep inside a biomechanical hive chamber, {operator} lying back into a protective cradle of black resin vanes and curved ivory struts with a rain-wet sheen, helmet sealed, the cradle half open like an articulated hand, a few hair-thin sensory filaments lifting toward the armour seams, emerald bioluminescent capillaries pulsing slowly behind the ribbed walls, warm mist hanging in the air, everything beyond the cradle dissolving into dark.
hive.lastFrame: the hive chamber wall lined with rows of closed translucent cocoons, each glowing softly emerald from within and breathing in unison, one holding the faint shape of the armoured operator, wet mist, monumental ivory ribs arching overhead into black.
hive.action: The ribs of the cradle close slowly over the operator like fingers folding, and a translucent membrane seals between them. Tendrils settle gently across the armour. The membrane rises and falls in a slow breathing rhythm; the visor inside picks up the emerald glow. The camera pulls back and up to reveal rows of breathing cocoons. Fade to black. No sudden movements, no gore.

squad.firstFrame: Three armoured operators inside the crash-site bunker at night: {engineer} lying asleep on a steel cot under a foil blanket, {scout} asleep on a second cot, and {tank} sitting on an ammo crate by the open bunker door with a rifle across their knees keeping watch, all helmets sealed, a single caged amber lamp hanging between them, cold fog drifting in through the doorway from the black outside, the crashed ship's hull looming behind, its ribs fused with sinuous biomechanical sinew like a ribcage.
squad.lastFrame: the same bunker in deep dusk: the sleepers still under their blankets, the watcher's helmet tipped forward in sleep against the door frame with the rifle across their knees, the amber lamp guttered to a faint ember glow, the first thin grey-blue light of dawn touching the fog in the doorway.
squad.action: Slow lateral dolly from the sleeping operators across to the watcher at the door. Out in the dark beyond the doorway a distant cold glow drifts left to right and disappears; the watcher's visor tracks it. A long still moment. The watcher's head slowly nods forward in sleep. The lamp gutters low. Faint grey dawn light rises at the doorway. Fade to black.
